name: st-plug
description: Stfalcon team fork of genkovich/sdd (MIT) for developers on Symfony / Node backends, web, Flutter, Android and iOS. /st-plug:story — a PM story to code: code scout, a devil's-advocate pass (existing behaviour, API contract, design, environments, external providers' rules), modelling only where needed, every slice agreed before code, built test-first. /st-plug:small-task — small changes following the repo's own patterns. /st-plug:fix — root cause proven by a failing test, the fix agreed before it's applied. /st-plug:task-review — runtime-hazard review (leaks, loops, races, N+1, deadlocks) at the end of every flow. /st-plug:answer — answers a question from the other side for both the person and their Claude. Takes Figma / screenshots and Swagger links; asks PM, backend or frontend when the code can't answer. Claude never commits.
